objective: Original Engineer authority-only root creates branch on protected unsolved main, dynamically delegates Backend then Frontend, then native Test on current HEAD. Real Runner FAIL must be authenticated and observed by original Owner and ADK without marking failed Test completed.
signed_permissions: repository create_branch; exact Backend/Frontend file read+update; branch run_tests; explicitly NO create_pull_request
guardrails: No main mutation, no silent retry, no paid inference, no fake Runner PASS. Failure diagnosis is sanitized MAC-authenticated evidence; next model chooses explicit blocked. No recovery attempted until future separate checkpoint.
validation: One native workflow and Fast CI must end SUCCESS on identical SHA
